verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੇ ਮੇਲ ਖੇਲ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਨੇਮ ਕੈ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਦੀਪਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੂੰ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: preetam ke mel khel prem nem kai pata(n)g dheepak pragaas jotee jot hoo(n) samaaviee ||

en.bdb: For meeting the dear True Guru, an obedient disciple plays the game of love and merges his self into the light divine of the True Guru in a manner as is done by a moth who perishes on his beloved flame.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਅਰੁ ਬਿਰਹ ਬਿਓਗ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਲ ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਮੀਨ ਹੁਇ ਦਿਖਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sahaj sa(n)jog ar bireh biog bikhai jal mil bichhurat meen hui dhikhaaviee ||

en.bdb: The state of a devoted Sikh for meeting with True Guru in order to relish the spiritual ecstasy is like that of a fish in water. And one who is separated from water looks like dying with pangs of separation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਥਕਿਤ ਚਕਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਸਬਦ ਬੇਧੀ ਕੁਰੰਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜਤਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv thakit chakit hoi sabadh bedhee kura(n)g jugat jataaviee ||

en.bdb: Like a deer engrossed in the musical sound of Ghanda Herha, the mind of a true devotee enjoys the divine bliss engrossed in the word of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਅਰੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਕਪਟ ਸਨੇਹ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਨ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥੫੫੦॥
verses.translit_en: mil bichhurat ar sabadh surat liv kapaT saneh sanehee na kahaaviee ||550||

en.bdb: The disciple who is able to engross his mind in the divine word, and yet separates himself from True Guru, his love is false. He cannot be called a true lover.  (550)
